title: Patient Health Questionnaire - 9
instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

questions.text: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself or that you have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed, or the opposite being so restless that you move around more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself
